PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday AUGUST 10, 2017
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Commissioner Avery, French, and Ward
4. Selection of Vice Chair Position
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of July 13, 2017
8
9. Public Hearing OLD BUSINESS:
9A. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 61940 Time Extension 1
Grace Builders, LLC, Applicant
(Continued from the July 13, 2017 Planning Commission meeting)
A request for a three-year time extension to subdivide approximately five acres into 16 single-family residential lots and one detention basin lot located at the northeast corner of Avenue S-8 and 42nd Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-025 approving TTM 61940 TE 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for the project Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
9A
9B. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-010
Romy Colin, Applicant
(Continued from the July 13, 2017 Planning Commission meeting)
A request to establish a religious assembly use (Iglesia Misionera Jesucristo Viene Pronto) within an existing tenant space located at 38750 Trade Center Drive, Suite C.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-026 approving a request to establish a religious assembly use (Iglesia Misionera Jesucristo Viene Pronto) within an existing 990 square foot tenant space and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. NEW BUSINESS: Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9B
9C. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 02-10 Major Modification 2
Iglesia De Cristo Miel Antelope Valley, Inc., Applicant
A request to expand an existing religious assembly use with an approximately 15,293 square foot building located at 1675 East Avenue Q-15.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-030 approving a request to expand an existing religious assembly use (Iglesia De Cristo Meil Antelope Valley) with an approximately 15,000 square foot building, concrete pad for future outside activities and associated parking and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9C
10. Staff Communications
10A. Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10B. Subdivision Maps Training
Noel Doran, Assistant City Planner
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, September 14, 2017, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
